scientific_integrity: Exact finite laws analytically proved; asymptotic statements use classical conditional and martingale limit theorems with stated hypotheses. Checker supports finite algebra but not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Even balanced initial populations, full independent Bernoulli resets, one same-colour addition per reinforcement step. Limit theorem assumes reset probability tends to zero. Brownian-reset Laplace law is previously known; new scope is its exact reinforced-urn scaling connection. No independent historical audit.
title: A Gaussian-to-Laplace stationary crossover for a resetting Pólya urn
